title: Virgin Nerd
paragraphs: “Motoyasu-san…”
“What is it?”
“You love Filolials no matter what form they take, right?”
“Of course!”
What is he talking about? To me, Filolials are beings to be loved regardless of their form.
“Ren and Itsuki are acting all high and mighty… and the Filolials are all focused on Motoyasu-kun!”
“At least there’s no gossip about them!”
“Indeed.”

What are they so smug about? I’m not sure, but I suppose it’s safe to say the elder sister has won this round. Come to think of it, I seem to recall the Filolials mentioning that the Father from the first world made a similar promise.
“If you’re worried about age, then just wait until they reach adulthood. Naofumi, there are quite a few among the ones you’ve protected who feel that way.”
At Ren’s words, Father seemed to lose all strength.
“I don’t understand why Ren and Itsuki are going along with Sadeena-san’s strange behavior, but… you’re saying I have to take responsibility, right?”
“If you reject someone who feels as strongly as Imiya-san does, it’ll hurt, won’t it?”
“In this world, just being associated with a hero or being a hero’s child is highly valued. So, dreaming of a harem isn’t so far-fetched. Look at King Faubrey.”
“Becoming a Pig King is out of the question! Ugh… I’ll do my best to delay this until Imiya-chan is truly of age.”
“Oh my, I’ll be watching over you.”
“You’re definitely planning to get involved, aren’t you? With that attitude!”
Father snaps at the elder sister. But… is it just my imagination, or does Father seem to be enjoying this a little?
“It might not be my place to say this since we encouraged it, but Naofumi-san doesn’t really judge people by appearance, does he?”
“True. Sadeena and Larsa can switch to humanoid forms, so most people would be fine with that. But when it comes to beastmen, there are probably those who wouldn’t be able to handle it.”
“Even Takt had a harem, but none of them were beastmen like Imiya-san.”
“Ah, right. He even called Imiya distasteful…”

Yes, that did happen. But Takt is the kind of person who judges people by their looks. He could never understand Father’s heart. He’s like how I used to be, choosing based solely on appearance. If someone didn’t look good, he’d probably call them disgusting. The fact that he called Mole distasteful is proof enough. As for me, I love Filo-tan no matter what form she takes. I could talk forever about the beauty of Filo-tan in her Filolial form. I love her angelic form too, but her Filolial form perfectly captures her cuteness. More than anything, I love Filo-tan not just for her appearance, but for her heart.
“Maybe it’s a requirement for those chosen as the Shield Hero?”
“Well, considering he’s a hero from a demi-human country, I guess it’s not a problem if they’re humanoid. And Imiya isn’t fully a mole, after all.”
“Um…”
Father looks like he wants to say something.
“Gaelion wants to loop…”
At that moment, Rival mutters softly, glaring resentfully at the elder sister.
“By that logic, shouldn’t Gaelion-san be able to join the gatherings too? He’s a dragon, after all.”
“No, Gaelion-chan is still a child! Even if Imiya-chan is considered an adult!”
“Gaelion wants to loop…”
“Hey… lately, Gaelion’s been saying nothing but that…”
Assistant looks troubled as they protest to us. Is that so? I wasn’t paying attention at all since I couldn’t care less about Rival.
“Wyndia, do you understand the recent changes?”
“Yeah. It’s about the Shield Hero getting together with Sadeena-san and mating with Larsa-san at night, right?”
“Ugh… Hearing that from Wyndia-chan is a shock…”
“Also, saying ‘mating’ makes it sound way too raw.”
“She was raised by a dragon, after all. That’s just how Wyndia is.”
Assistant’s perspective seems to be based on monsters. She doesn’t use human-like terms like s**.

“Do you want to include Gaelion in that? Well, Gaelion has been trying to seduce the Shield Hero all along. Even when we went to challenge her father, she said, ‘Let him be apart from Gaelion for a while so he can understand the loneliness! Love is all about strategy!’”
“Yeah, she did say that.”
“She really said that…?”
“Gaelion wants to loop…”
There it is again. Is that her cry or something? And her eyes look lifeless.
“It’s natural for a strong male to surround himself with females. If Imiya-chan likes the Shield Hero, I think it’s fine, and if Gaelion wants that, isn’t it okay?”
“That’s pretty cold.”
“Her instincts are still wild. I guess we’ll have to teach her the manners to bring her closer to human behavior.”
“That’s Naofumi-san and Sadeena-san’s job, isn’t it?”
“I agree with that part.”
“Oh my.”
“Gaelion wants to loop…”
The elder sister laughs joyfully. But Rival has been looping and looping nonstop for a while now.
“Based on everything that’s happened so far, I’m getting the feeling that Gaelion thinks Naofumi-san was stolen away by Sadeena-san, right?”
“Stolen…? I wasn’t dating Gaelion-chan, though.”
“It’s stolen!”
Rival stomps her feet as she declares this. Suddenly snapping… well, that’s a dragon for you.
“I was so close to conquering Naofumi, but that woman intercepted me at the last moment!”
With a dramatic point, Rival directs her finger at the elder sister.
“It was a mistake! Gaelion’s mistake was focusing her rivalry on the Filolial! I never realized Naofumi actually prefers older women who protect him!”
“What do you mean by ‘Filolial’!?”
Depending on the answer, I’ll have to kill her!
“Motoyasu, calm down!”
“Yes, calm down. She’s just confused right now!”
As I gripped my spear tightly, Ren and Itsuki held me back. Tch! They’re getting in my way.
“Oh my? I’m pretty sure Gaelion-chan can transform into a human, right? Then why not just match her transformation to be about my age? Let’s all enjoy the feast of lust together.”
“That’s not—”
“I don’t want to!”
Rival forcefully slapped away the elder sister’s outstretched hand. Oh?
“Gaelion wanted to be Naofumi’s first! After that, anything would have been fine!”
“How should I put this… I’ve heard of the term ‘virgin fetish,’ but this is the first time I’ve seen someone obsessed with taking someone’s virginity.”
“In stories, there are dragons that desire virgins just to devour them, but a dragon that desires a man’s first time… what a nasty dragon.”
“Um…”

This is becoming quite a bizarre situation. If it were the Father from the first world, his patience would have snapped by now. Probably around the time the elder sister started talking about the feast.
“Naofumi has already lost his virginity to that woman over there. Gaelion can’t make him hers anymore… It’s over… Oooooooohhhh…”

Like a waterfall, Rival shed tears while stomping her feet. Hah! I won’t let things go the way Rival wants! Isn’t this great, Father? As I flashed a victorious smile and gave a thumbs-up, Father looked completely drained.
“So, to claim Naofumi-san’s virginity, looping is the only way left.”
“Oooooooohhhh…”
Rival nodded with tears streaming down.
“But the only one who can accurately recognize the loops is Motoyasu-san, and even if you looped, Gaelion-san wouldn’t be able to perceive it, right?”
“Besides, Motoyasu hates dragons. I doubt he’d tell you anything.”
At that, Rival wiped her tears and then glared at us with a determined look as she took a step forward.
“It’s fine! Gaelion has already found a way to solve that problem!”
“What?”
“What do you mean?”
Rival puffed out her chest proudly, her eyes still teary but full of confidence. What is she planning now!?
“Anticipating something like this, Gaelion kept in constant contact with the Spear Hero’s spear to ensure everything wouldn’t be undone.”
“Huh? When did she have time to do that!? This is the first I’m hearing of it!”
“Recently, Gaelion endured the Filolial stench while the Spear Hero was sleeping and kept working hard on it!”
“What did you say!?”
What’s this? My heart rate is steadily rising, and cold sweat won’t stop running down my back.
What’s happening here!?
“If there’s a dragon egg near the spear after a loop, it can access it and draw Gaelion’s soul, inheriting her memories as they are. It’s perfect!”
After saying that, Rival gazed into the distance with a dreamy expression.
